name: SaaSList

sources.title: SaaSList homepage — business software comparison with QuoteMatch tool

requirements: B2B SaaS only — categories are business software (CRM, helpdesk, VoIP, call center, conferencing, project management, etc.)
No public vendor submission form was found on the homepage; the product appears to be a buyer-side comparison/quote-matching service
Listings likely curated by the operator ('Prescreened Matches' via QuoteMatch) — vendor inclusion path is unpublished
preparation: Vendor/company details and category fit if a contact route is located
Published pricing and review-worthy product information (they surface provider counts and user reviews per category)
workflow: Search saaslist.com categories for your product — it may already be listed as a provider
If absent, look for a vendor/contact route (none surfaced on the homepage at retrieval) or reach the operator via any contact page/social profile
Inclusion appears editorial/curated rather than self-serve
watchFor: Lead-gen model ('Get Quotes', 'Prescreened Matches') — vendors likely pay per lead or are invited, not submitted
Do not confuse with similarly named SaaS directories — this is a comparison engine
No submission CTA exists on the homepage; third-party launch lists may be overstating its openness
User reviews per category suggest a claimed/vendored listing model
countsAsLive: A provider profile within a SaaSList category (e.g., CRM Software) with user reviews displayed
unknowns: Whether vendors can request a listing at all, and via what channel
Free vs paid placement for vendors
Whether outbound links exist on provider profiles
Whether the site is actively maintained
